item.title: Illumination Takes Over Macy’s Parade With New Not Alone Thanksgiving Teaser
item.description: There's no doubt that 2026 has been a great year for Illumination. It had one of the biggest releases of the year with The Super Mario Galaxy Movie in April, earning over $1 billion. Then, in June, it released another hit Minion movie, Minions & Monsters , which made $531 million. It's no surprise that fans were looking forward to more from the animation company.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering’s Most Notorious Vampire Almost Broke Commander
item.description: Most Commanders in Magic: The Gathering have to show up on the battlefield before they can do anything. But Edgar Markov can make you the most dangerous player at the table while he’s still sitting in the Command Zone. Cast a one-mana vampire on your first turn, and Edgar gives you a second vampire for free. Do it twice on turn two, and you have six creatures before some players have cast their first spell.

item.title: 5 Years Later, an Avengers: Doomsday Hero's Next MCU Adventure Is Finally Moving Forward
item.description: Shang-Chi is getting ready to return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Avengers: Doomsday , but fans hoping to see more of the hero have another reason to be optimistic. Dave Callaham, who co-wrote Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings , has confirmed that he's working on a sequel, offering the clearest sign yet that the character's next solo adventure is moving forward.

item.title: 10 Best Black Friday 2026 Book Deals For Sci-Fi and Fantasy Fans
item.description: Books make a perfect gift. They offer the chance to introduce a friend or family member to a story or world you love and adventures you can share together. You can even use a book as a seed for future gift ideas by getting someone hooked on a series. Black Friday sales offer plenty of bargains on fantasy and sci-fi classics and recent genre standouts for anyone looking to get an early start on holiday shopping. Even if you’re just looking for some reading material for your vacation, you should check out the 10 best Black Friday book deals.

item.title: Stephen King's Psychological Thriller Officially Says Goodbye to Streaming
item.description: Stephen King’s books have inspired countless adaptations over the years. Several have even been adapted for the screen more than once, including Firestarter (1984 and 2022) and The Running Man (1987 and 2025).

item.title: 8 Essential Thriller Books Everyone Should Read at Least Once
item.description: Take genre staples like Gone Girl or The Silent Patient . While the two couldn’t be more different in tone and subject matter, both thrillers heavily rely on misdirection and the recontextualization of events to deliver twists. These picks are a staple in every “must-read” list for good reason, just like the ones Polygon has highlighted below as genre essentials. Without further ado, here are eight thriller books you should read at least once in your life.

item.title: 8 Funniest ‘Far Side’ Comics About Fruits and Vegetables
item.description: Decades after Gary Larson concluded his comic strip The Far Side back in 1995, fans of the series continue to read it regularly, and new fans are discovering it all the time. Some of Larson’s most beloved comic strips feature animals drawn in his signature style, including dogs, chickens, and especially cows . He often gave these animals human-like intelligence and other anthropomorphic traits and depicted them in very human-like scenarios.

item.title: Star Trek: Voyager Officially Revisits the Series' Best Two-Parter in a Brand-New Way
item.description: One of the best two-episode arcs in Star Trek: Voyager , if not the entire Star Trek franchise, is the "Year of Hell" duology. The story from the show's fourth season pitted the crew of Voyager against a unique threat that tested their perseverance more than any previous enemy had.

item.title: GTA: Boston Would Go Wicked Hard, Kid
item.description: Considering that Grand Theft Auto 6 just launched after a 13-year wait, it’s safe to say that we won’t be getting another one any time soon. That’s fine, because Leonida is so enormous that I know I’ll still be finding secrets in it years from now. And yet, I can’t help myself. I’m already wondering where the series could possibly go next. Allow me to offer one unsolicited idea: Massachusetts.

item.title: The Sims 4 Officially Makes 13 DLCs Free for a Limited Time
item.description: The Sims 4 has received a steady stream of content since it launched 12 years ago. However, 2026 has been particularly dry. The last major expansion, Royalty & Legacy , was released in February, and aside from kits, the game hasn't received much content this year. This may be because of the team's focus on Project Renee (which may be on hold) or because of internal matters related to Electronic Arts' private-equity buyout .
